mapper.select: SELECT r.rno,r.uno,p.pno,r.r_content,r.r_img,r.r_score,u.profile_img,TO_CHAR(r.r_created_at,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') as dbday, p.thumbnail as thumbnail, TO_CHAR(r.r_updated_at,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') as uday, p.category as category, p.type as type, p.name as pname, CASE WHEN p.type IN ('연극/뮤지컬','전시','액티비티') THEN 'culture' WHEN p.type IN ('명소','자연관광','엔터테인먼트') THEN 'attraction' WHEN p.category IN ('식당') THEN 'restaurant' END AS placeType FROM review r JOIN users u ON r.uno=u.uno JOIN place p ON r.pno=p.pno WHERE r.uno=#{uno} ORDER BY r.rno DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
